title: Share UPI requests
description: Scan a UPI QR and share the payment details with a trusted person through WhatsApp or another app.

title: Keep a local transaction history
description: Review requests, repayment notes, optional proof, and contact balances stored on your device.

title: Open source
description: Review the app source code and report issues on GitHub.
